raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Makes the compile backend configurable for TorchTitan local compile regions, FlexAttention, and block-mask helpers. `inductor` remains the default.

## User Example

```python
config.model.local_compile_backend = "custom_device_backend"
config.model.local_compile_regions = ["loss", "cos_sin_rope"]
```

## Before the Change

```text
model.parallelize(regions)
  -> apply_local_compile(regions)
  -> torch.compile(region)                    # implicit Inductor

module import
  -> torch.compile(FlexAttention, options=...) # implicit Inductor
  -> torch.compile(create_block_mask)          # implicit Inductor
```

## After the Change

```text
model config backend
  -> TrainingEngine: set_local_compile_backend(backend)
  -> process-wide backend
       |
       +-> apply_local_compile(regions)
       |    -> torch.compile(region, backend=backend)
       |
       +-> first FlexAttention use
       |    -> torch.compile(FlexAttention, backend=backend)
       |
       +-> first block-mask use
            -> torch.compile(create_block_mask, backend=backend)
```

## Test

Run with Python 3.11, nightly CPU PyTorch, and the repository CPU/Transformers-modeling requirements:

```console
python -m pytest -q \
  tests/unit_tests/cpu/config/test_compile_config.py \
  tests/unit_tests/cpu/test_trainer.py::test_parallelize_compile_kwargs_include_regions_only \
  tests/unit_tests/cpu/test_trainer.py::test_seed_checkpoint_initialize_skips_forward_backward \
  torchtitan/experiments/transformers_modeling_backend/tests/test_flex_attention.py::TestHFTransformerConfig
```

```text
12 passed in 8.73s
```

-__all__ = ["apply_local_compile", "local_compile"]
+def compiled(
+    reference: Callable[..., Any],
+    *,
+    inductor_options: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+    **compile_kwargs: Any,
+) -> Callable[..., Any]:
+    """Compile ``reference`` lazily with the configured local backend.
+
+    ``inductor_options`` are passed as ``torch.compile(options=...)`` only when
+    the effective backend is Inductor.
+    """
+    explicit_backend = compile_kwargs.pop("backend", None)
+    explicit_options = compile_kwargs.pop("options", None)
+    fn: Callable[..., Any] | None = None
+
+    def reset() -> None:
+        nonlocal fn
+        fn = None
+
+    @functools.wraps(reference)
+    def wrapped(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
+        nonlocal fn
+        if fn is None:
+            backend = _BACKEND if explicit_backend is None else explicit_backend
+            options = explicit_options
+            if backend == "inductor" and inductor_options is not None:
+                options = inductor_options
+            if options is None:
+                fn = torch.compile(
+                    reference,
+                    backend=backend,
+                    **compile_kwargs,
+                )
+            else:
+                fn = torch.compile(
+                    reference,
+                    backend=backend,
+                    options=options,
+                    **compile_kwargs,
+                )
+        return fn(*args, **kwargs)
+
+    _COMPILED_HELPER_RESETS.append(reset)
+    return wrapped
+
+
